content.text:
I sorted todos high, then med, then low, keeping the order they were added within each priority. I haven't tested it in a browser.
DEC-003 still applies: all active todos come first, and completed todos stay below them, also sorted by priority.
I rejected sorting by priority alone, because a completed high todo would then show above an active low one and break DEC-003.
